test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Proteg.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Incorrectly spelt word is Proteg.
 
• **This word doesn't make any** sense.
 
• Thus the correct answer is Proteg.​
 
• The correct spelling is** protege** which means **a person who is guided and supported by an older and more experienced or influential person.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pried is the past tense of pry, which means **to be too interested in the affairs of another.**
 
• **Prophet **has a meaning, its means **a person who is regarded as a divinely inspired teacher or preacher.**
 
• **Prodigy **has a meaning, its means **a young person with exceptional qualities or abilities.**
